verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that the official Marqeta MCP Server lets agents query a designated set of Core API endpoints. That is a fixed, server-level restriction on what an agent can reach, not user-issued scoped credentials. The card velocity, authorization and spend controls limit card spending, not API access, so they do not count here. Missing for 10: the ability to issue per-agent API keys or tokens, configurable permission scopes or roles, read-only versus write credential options, credential rotation or revocation docs, and any independent corroboration.
